subject: SIG/ISO: Evidence delegation & audit trail consolidation for NEXUS RFP
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexuscorp.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nexuscorp.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NEXUS RFP - SIG/ISO evidence scope and timeline

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick response at the RFP stage. Our security team has a tight window and needs a clarified scope so we can complete our third‑party SIG review by May 3. Specifically: which controls will you map to the SIG questionnaire, and can you provide an audit‑log sample and a short list of custodians who can deliver artifacts on short notice?

Also note we will share your answers with our external assessor (cc'd Evan). If possible could you indicate a point person for any follow‑up technical deep dives?

Laura
Laura Chen
Senior Procurement Manager, NEXUS Corp

Attachment: NEXUS_RFP_instructions.pdf (pdf stub)

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexuscorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, Evan Price <evan.price@auditpartners.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NEXUS RFP - SIG/ISO evidence scope and timeline

Laura —

Thanks for the clear ask. We're on the same page about the deadline. Quick answers up front:
- Scope: We will map SIG L3 + SOC 2 (CC and Trust Services Criteria) and provide a crosswalk to ISO 27001 controls where relevant.
- Audit logs: we can provide a redacted sample export (event types, timestamps, principal ids); see referenced attachment we will send by EOD.
- Custodians: Kimberly will be the runbook owner for artifact pickup; Jonas will support telemetry and infra proofs.

Proposed next steps:
1) We share a control‑mapping workbook that indicates which artifacts we can provide immediately, which require short preparation, and which will need custodian verification.
2) We schedule a 30‑minute deep‑dive with your assessor (Evan) to walk through KV cache / runtime telemetry and log retention.
3) We produce an artifact index CSV and a sample audit log JSON by tomorrow EOD.

Can you confirm Evan's availability tomorrow afternoon (Tue) or Wed morning?

Thanks — happy to own coordination here.

—Jordan Blake
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555‑0174

Attachment: (placeholder) control-mapping-NEXUS-v1.xlsx (will follow)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexuscorp.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Evan Price <evan.price@auditpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NEXUS RFP - SIG/ISO evidence scope and timeline

Laura / Evan —

I uploaded a first‑pass control mapping and an evidence index to the shared folder (link below). Highlights from the workbook (control‑mapping‑tab):
- We mark "Available as artifact" for controls related to access provisioning, key management integration points, and SOC2 change management records.
- Runtime telemetry: we supply recent KV cache metrics, scheduler audit events, and per‑deployment request traces (redacted identifiers). Those map to SIG items DATAFLOW‑7, OPS‑4, and CRYPTO‑2 in your questionnaire.
- Retention windows: audit logs retained for 365 days by default (configurable on Dedicated/Private).

Practical notes:
- Custodians: Myself (kimberly_park) for artifacts, and Jonas for telemetry/infra proofs. We can produce notarized export bundles if required by your assessor, but will need a day to sanitize PII.
- Attachments included here: control‑mapping‑NEXUS‑v1.xlsx, nexus_artifact_index.csv, audit-log-sample-2027-04.json.

If Evan can do a deep‑dive Wed 10:00–11:00 PT, we will block that on our side (Jonas and I). Otherwise propose Wed 15:00 PT.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNEXUS-RFP-evidence

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: control-mapping-NEXUS-v1.xlsx (xlsx stub), nexus_artifact_index.csv (csv stub), audit-log-sample-2027-04.json (json stub)

From: Evan Price <evan.price@auditpartners.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexuscorp.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NEXUS RFP - SIG/ISO evidence scope and timeline

Thanks — this looks good. A couple of clarifying notes from the assessor POV:
- For the audit log sample, we'll need a brief mapping that shows event name → control assertion (e.g., login_success → AUTHZ‑01). A one‑page mapping is sufficient.
- Please confirm whether the redaction process removes IP addresses and full user emails; pseudonymous IDs are fine.
- For controls that point to cloud provider configs, we need screenshots + timestamped exports to validate configuration drift windows.

Wed 10:00 PT works for me for the 30‑minute call. Could you send a calendar invite? Also share any DocuSign links if there are NDAs or evidence access agreements.

—Evan Price
Lead Assessor, Audit Partners

Attachment referenced: assessment-scope-template.docx (docx stub)

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexuscorp.com>, Evan Price <evan.price@auditpartners.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NEXUS RFP - SIG/ISO evidence scope and timeline

Laura / Evan —

Thanks — invite sent for Wed 10:00 PT (we'll send from calendar invite for your timezone). Action items we will complete before the call:
- Kimberly: deliver a one‑page event→assertion mapping and finalize the sanitized audit‑log sample (today EOD).
- Jonas: capture the timestamped cloud config exports and a short note on drift detection cadence (tomorrow morning).
- Jordan: prepare the executive summary that ties SIG L3 answers to SOC 2 evidence locations (control‑mapping workbook).

If Nexus needs DocuSign for our limited evidence access agreement, please share the link and we'll sign prior to the call. Otherwise we'll use a shared Drive with granular permissions for the artifacts.

Look forward to the call — we will be prepared to walk Evan through runtime telemetry and our retention model.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555‑0174

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=NEXUS-RFP-47-CALL
